charts.title: TOI-406 c: orbits around TOI-406
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-406's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-406 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Lacedelli et al. 2024 (2024A&A...692A.238L), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname LACEDELLI_ET_AL_2024): P 3.307441 d

charts.title: TOI-406 c: its transit
charts.description: TOI-406 c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (97, 105, 106) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 153065527, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 4 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 36 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 4-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 4 min late; 4-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 12 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
